title: H&M AU defective goods return
policy_text: A defective item should be reported promptly. If H&M deems it defective, a full refund including the return fee is provided. Material, manufacturing and transit damage are covered by statutory guarantees.
policy_source: H&M Australia Terms and Conditions, sections 5, 6 and 10

title: H&M AU order mismatch review
policy_text: A product mismatch is routed for order verification. This is an internal prototype control and is not presented as an H&M policy clause.
policy_source: Project control linked to H&M AU order records

title: Insufficient visual evidence review
policy_text: When no visible defect is detected, the prototype does not auto-approve a damage refund and requests review or additional evidence.
policy_source: Project evidence-safety rule; H&M source requires an item to be deemed defective

title: H&M AU restricted return categories
policy_text: Change-of-mind returns exclude personal-care products, underwear, swimwear, hosiery, perfume, beauty products and purchased paper bags. Statutory rights for defective goods remain available.
policy_source: H&M Australia Terms and Conditions, section 6

title: Zara AU defective goods return
policy_text: The standard deadline does not restrict items that are defective, not of acceptable quality, not fit for purpose or incorrectly described. The drop-off fee is not deducted for those items.

title: Zara AU standard return conditions
policy_text: Online returns must be managed within 30 days from shipping. Items must remain in original condition with labels and be returned in the same market.

title: UNIQLO AU faulty item return
policy_text: Faulty items may be assessed with a receipt or other proof of purchase, or referred to Customer Care for online handling. Australian Consumer Law rights continue to apply.

title: UNIQLO AU online change-of-mind return
policy_text: Online change-of-mind returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery or collection when items are unworn, unwashed and include original packaging and tags. Online refunds are returned by post.
